name: Kouga Genzou
source:
Hobbies: Japanese sake.
Likes: Moments that change other people's destinies.

Kouga Genzou is a powerful person who reigns over Okushima. He is the head of the Kouga family, and it is said that no wish of his can go unfulfilled in Okushima. Despite being nearly 100 years old, he is ruthless and greedy. He is an old monster who has devoured the lives of others for his own sake and harbors no remorse or fear. In order to fulfill the greatest "wish" of his life, he searches for the whereabouts of Tsuki, who has disappeared.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=933594&gc=gc]Getchu[/url].]
